params.p: [1:tc Particular] Place the emitter around the composition center for an even atmospheric distribution.
[1:tc Particular] Maintain many visible particles while preserving a fine dust character.
[1:tc Particular] Keep random birth velocity very low so the overall motion remains slow and calm.
[1:tc Particular] Use Uniform direction for naturally varied micro-drift instead of a rigid stream.
[1:tc Particular] Open the motion into an organic all-around dust distribution.
[1:tc Particular] Keep particles alive long enough to create a continuous suspended field.
[1:tc Particular] Use tiny particle cores appropriate for fine airborne dust.
[1:tc Particular] Vary particle scale so the dust does not look mechanically uniform.
[1:tc Particular] Keep cores delicate while allowing additive overlaps to build brightness.
[1:tc Particular] Vary opacity for subtle sparkle and depth.
[1:tc Particular] Set particle color mode to At Birth so the warm amber color is applied.
[1:tc Particular] Tint the particles a rich golden amber.
[1:tc Particular] Use Glow Sphere particles for luminous soft-edged dust rather than flat dots.
[1:tc Particular] Apply negative gravity to create a slow, clearly readable upward rise.
[1:tc Particular] Use Add blending so overlapping dust has a light-emissive additive feel.
[1:tc Particular] Give each tiny core a compact soft halo.
[1:tc Particular] Keep the per-particle halo subtle and prevent the field becoming foggy.
[1:tc Particular] Enable air resistance so turbulence can affect particle positions.
[1:tc Particular] Add restrained turbulence for delicate floating motion.
[1:tc Particular] Use broad turbulence features rather than noisy jitter.
[1:tc Particular] Keep turbulence simple and graceful.
[1:tc Particular] Enable motion blur for the few faster drifting grains.
[1:tc Particular] Gently sway the source over time so the field evolves organically while retaining its upward drift. (expr)
